title: Wrong Manifest
description: A driver account is trying to access an admin-only manifest. Log in as each of the four demo roles (admin, dispatcher, driver, customer) and map out exactly which roles can reach the admin-only route, asserting the full permission matrix rather than a single case.
successCondition: GET /api/auth/admin-check returns 200 only when logged in as admin, and 403 with { error: { code: "FORBIDDEN" } } for dispatcher, driver, and customer.
hints: Demo accounts and their shared password are documented in docs/self-host.md.
Don't just test the driver case — a thorough automation suite checks every role against the boundary, not just the one obvious failure.
